name: Product development specialist (physical goods)
summary: Takes a physical product from idea to factory-ready: requirements, prototypes, tech packs, manufacturer briefs and cost of goods.

changelog.note: First release: 29 sources (EU GPSR, product liability, CE marking; UK OPSS and UKCA; US CPSC certificates, labs and duty to report; ICC Incoterms; tariff tools; textile labels; DFM guides), four skills, five prompts, two workflows, training. Level 3 covers routine supplier messages within limits; purchase orders, supplier contracts and binding quotes need a fresh yes; tooling payments stay with the client.
